paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The evaluation of inference methods using an A100 80GB GPU on LLaMA 2-13B and 70B. Length: prefill length + generation length. Bsz: batch size. KV mem.: GPU memory usage (GB) of the KV cache. Thr.: throughput (token/s) : S_r ratio ablation study.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio and two different metrics: perplexity and GPU memory ratio. The x-axis is labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 100, and tick labels at intervals of 20. The left y-axis is labeled "Perplexity" with a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The right y-axis is labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)" with a linear scale from 40 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The first line is orange, represented with circular markers and a solid style. Starting around a perplexity of just below 4.6 at a recent sequence ratio of 5%, it declines sharply to around 4.3 at 40%, then shows a small increase and remains steady before rising again to approximately 4.4 at 100%. The second line is blue, marked with circular markers and a solid style, beginning at a GPU memory ratio of 40% at 5% recent sequence ratio, gradually increasing to approximately 100% at 100%. Two additional horizontal reference lines are present: a red dashed line at a perplexity of just below 4.4 labeled "Full Cache PPL," and a blue dashed line at a GPU memory ratio of 100% labeled "Full Cache GPU Mem". A legend is placed at the top center if the plot.
